profile.name: Acme
profile.description: Design tools for people who ship.

voice.sample: We build tools that get out of your way, so you can do the best work of your life.

mission.statement: Give every team the tools to turn a good idea into a finished, consistent brand.

values.title: Craft
values.description: Details matter. We sweat the small things so nobody else has to.

values.title: Clarity
values.description: Plain words and honest defaults beat clever tricks.

values.title: Openness
values.description: We build in public, share what we learn and welcome help.

values.title: Care
values.description: Every choice starts with the people who use what we make.

content.subtitle: Open source. Local first. Free forever.
